title: Umuvumo w'umwimbu mwinshi
intro: Mu gihugu ca kera, hari umutima kanaka wari uhagaze mu batunzi kuruta abandi bose bo mu kibano cabo. Imihezagiro y’isi yari yarabashikiye incuro zibiri mu myaka ikurikiranye, umwimbu w’incuro zibiri wari ukwiye kwuzuza imitima yabo ugukenguruka. Yamara igihe icago cabaye, ivyo bari bafise vyose bikatwarwa mw’ijoro rimwe, inyishu batanga yarahishuye kamere nyakuri y’umutima wabo. Woba ushobora guhishura akaranga k’uwo muntu inkuru yiwe ikora nk’imburi ku bijanye no kutemera imihezagiro ya Allah?
clues: Nari mu bantu bafise amahirwe kuruta abandi bose mu gihugu cose, nhezagiwe n’ibifungurwa vyinshi.
Ivyimburwa vyaje incuro zibiri mu myaka ibiri, yamara umutima wanje wagumye udakengurukira Umukama wanje.
Nari mfise itongo rinini ry’imizabibu, imyelayo n’imisukoni, ivyo bikaba ari igihe c’ugushimira Allah.
Igihe itongo ryanje ryasambuka, nahagaze mu bihome vyaryo n’amaboko arambuye mw’ijuru, nvuma iherezo ryanje.
Narahakanye ko Allah yari gushobora gutuma haba mwene ukwo gutakaza, mbere n’igihe namenagura ibiganza vyanje mu kwihebura.
Igihano canje nticari ugutakaza itongo ryanje gusa, ahubwo ni ugusigara ata co nshoboye rwose mu bihome vyaryo, ntashobora gusaba umufasha uwo ari we wese.

identity.label: Jewe ndi nde?
options: Nyir’imirima ibiri ava mu gihugu ca kure .
Umutima w'umutunzi uva mu gisagara c'uguterimbere .
Uwo murimyi avugwa muri Sura Al-Kahf .
Umurinzi w'umurima w'imizabibu wo mu gihe ca Muhanuzi Shu'aib
